name: Candlelight Concerts
description: Experience classical and contemporary music in a new light. These magical concerts take place in iconic Porto venues illuminated by thousands of candles.
longDescription:
Candlelight Concerts are a series of musical performances presented by Fever, an entertainment discovery platform. The series aims to make classical and contemporary music accessible to a wider audience by presenting it in a unique, atmospheric setting. Each concert features a program of well-known pieces, performed by local musicians, often string quartets or pianists, focusing on composers ranging from Vivaldi and Mozart to modern artists like Queen and Hans Zimmer.

Attendees experience an evening concert in historic Porto locations, transformed by the soft glow of thousands of candles. The atmosphere is designed to be intimate and reflective, allowing for focused listening to the musical program. Concerts typically last 60-75 minutes. The audience generally consists of adults and older teenagers interested in music and unique cultural experiences. The specific venues vary, but are selected for their architectural character and acoustic properties, contributing to the overall ambiance.

Tickets for Candlelight Concerts are available for purchase online, with prices starting from €15. Specific venue details and transport information will be provided upon ticket purchase, as locations vary across the series. Past venues have included churches and grand halls, often centrally located and accessible via Porto's metro and bus network. Some venues may have limited accessibility; it is advisable to check specific event details for information on wheelchair access.
